title: Add maxATAC to README.md
body:
### Added Tool
* **Tool Name**: maxATAC

### What it does
maxATAC is a Python package and deep learning framework for genome-scale transcription factor (TF) binding prediction from ATAC-seq signal and DNA sequence in human cell types. It works with bulk ATAC-seq and pseudobulk ATAC-seq profiles derived from single-cell ATAC-seq (scATAC-seq), predicting TF binding sites at 32 bp resolution.

### Why it is relevant to ATAC-seq analysis
maxATAC directly utilizes ATAC-seq accessibility signals combined with DNA sequence context to predict cell-type-specific TF binding sites across the genome, making it a valuable tool for TF footprinting and TFBS prediction from chromatin accessibility data.

### Links
* **Primary Software Source**: [https://github.com/MiraldiLab/maxATAC](https://github.com/MiraldiLab/maxATAC)
* **Associated Publication**: [PLOS Computational Biology (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1010863)
